title: Which Parts of the Sea Around Madeira Are Protected?
description: Garajau, Cabo Girão, Rocha do Navio, the Desertas, the Selvagens and Porto Santo all have protected sea. Where they are and what the rules mean for you.
heroAlt: Large groupers swimming close to the rocky bottom inside the Garajau marine reserve
keywords: which parts of the sea around Madeira are protected

images.prompt: Underwater photo over a rocky bottom at about 10 metres inside the Garajau reserve east of Funchal. Two large brown groupers hover calmly close to the volcanic rocks, a few small fish around them, soft sunlight rays from above, deep blue water behind. True colours, no divers, no text.
images.alt: Large groupers swimming close to the rocky bottom inside the Garajau marine reserve

images.prompt: Close underwater detail of a maërl bed on the seabed: loose pink and lilac chalky nodules of red algae spread over sand, a small fish passing, soft blue light.
images.alt: Maërl, loose nodules of chalky red algae, on the seabed off Madeira

images.prompt: The Rocha do Navio islets off the north coast at Santana seen from the cliff-top viewpoint, the dark islets in a deep blue sea fringed with white swell, green slopes in the foreground, morning light.
images.alt: The islets of the Rocha do Navio marine reserve off Santana
